razer - wolverine v4 pro wireless gaming.name: Razer - Wolverine V4 Pro Wireless Gaming Controller for Xbox Series X|S and PC with 8K Hz HyperPolling - Black
razer - wolverine v4 pro wireless gaming.description: The Razer Wolverine V4 Pro is a wireless pro controller designed for Xbox Series X|S and PC gamers who demand speed, precision, and customization. Whether you're competing in fast-paced FPS matches, racing simulations, sports titles, or action games, this controller delivers elite-level responsiveness and control. Built with next-generation capacitive thumbstick sensors, the Wolverine V4 Pro provides highly accurate tracking without the drift and wear commonly associated with traditional stick mechanisms. Included interchangeable thumbstick caps allow players to choose between a tall concave cap for precision aiming or a short domed cap for faster movement and control. Gain a competitive advantage with four removable mouse-click back buttons and two claw grip bumpers. Easily create the control layout that fits your playstyle and assign critical commands like pings, heals, equipment swaps, or movement actions for faster execution. Adapt instantly to different genres using adjustable Razer Pro HyperTriggers. Activate ultra-fast mouse-click trigger response for shooters or switch to full analog travel when precise throttle and braking control are needed for racing games. Unlock maximum responsiveness on PC with up to 8000 Hz polling for smoother input tracking and lower latency. Combined with Razer HyperSpeed Wireless connectivity, the controller delivers fast, reliable performance built for competitive gaming.  Create up to four custom profiles using Razer Synapse 4 or the Razer Controller App. Adjust button mappings, dead zones, trigger behavior, and other performance settings to optimize the controller for FPS, racing, sports, and action titles.
